That keg is in the contract's form, unlike 0.1.8's (devbin 0348). Doctor reads it against its own manifest, so the config's LICENSE entry, already on main, does not fail a keg without LICENSE. One thing this run cannot show is a release commit at 0.1.10 beside the 0.1.9 keg. But 0.1.9's cut passed with its opt tree at 0.1.8 under a 0.1.9 release commit, so the tree row reads the tree's own manifest and line, not the project's version. So hv cuts with brew as it is, and after the publish brew upgrade ccusage is the only switch step.
